current_checkpoint_note: Checkpoint 1.5 (Intelligence & Extensibility Architecture) -- architecture-only, no livestock feature/AI assistant/integration shipped. Full account: docs/farm-return-next/CHECKPOINT_1_5_ARCHITECTURE.md. Phase 0 inspection found most requested concepts already exist (TrackedValue/Provenance, three separate confidence/evidence-tier vocabularies, a real dated SourceReference registry, EngineOutcome as the existing structured-result envelope, IndividualAnimal/WeightObservation/LivestockGroup with real cross-farm-triggered tables) and one explicit prior rejection of a generic polymorphic subject/target database reference (jobs_weight_observation_reference.sql) -- informing the decision to keep every new subject/reference concept TypeScript-only, no migration. New: subject.ts (SubjectType/SubjectRef), evidence-item.ts (EvidenceKind/EvidenceItem, distinct from evidence.ts's EvidenceState), measurement.ts (Measurement<T>, reusing DataStatus/SubjectRef, not a WeightObservation retrofit), external-reference.ts (ExternalSystemKind/ExternalReference), orchestration/ai-context/index.ts (FarmContext/buildFarmContext/getFarmContextForCurrentUser -- the one genuinely new, real, working piece: a farm-scoped AI read boundary, no LLM connected, no caller-supplied farm id, defence-in-depth cross-farm filtering, test-enforced). evidence.ts gained one non-breaking additive explain field on ok()/EngineOutcome's OK branch. IndividualAnimal gained two optional not-yet-persisted fields (parentIds, lifecycleStatus); LivestockGroup deliberately left unchanged (already the ANIMAL_GROUP anchor). job_sessions/job_actuals/GPS Job Mode untouched. No migration. Quality gate: 1695/1695 tests (135/135 files), up from 1667/1667 (130/130), +28 new tests. Next: Codex audit loop. Round 1 Codex audit fixes now in: reviseMeasurement rejects a farm/subject change and cross-farm evidence; buildFarmContext preserves status/source (not a bare value) and requires an explicit generatedAt; evidence.ts's ok() defensively copies explain; IndividualAnimal's parentIds/lifecycleStatus moved to a new, separate FutureIndividualAnimalLifecycleFields type, never merged into the real entity. SubjectType's four not-yet-backed variants reviewed and kept (the brief's own item 1 names them verbatim), documented rather than silently dropped. Quality gate: 1702/1702 tests (135/135 files). Next: Codex audit round 2. Round 2 Codex audit fixes now in: measurement() itself (not just reviseMeasurement) now validates the whole .previous chain's own farm/subject/evidence and copies its evidence array; evidence.ts's copyExplanation uses structuredClone for a genuine deep copy of inputs; buildFarmContext copies farm.primaryEnterprises. Quality gate: 1709/1709 tests (135/135 files). Next: Codex audit round 3. Round 3 Codex audit fixes now in: measurement()'s own metadata is deep-copied at its own construction level (subject, evidence items + their externalReferences) and its inherited previous chain is validated then frozen recursively in place (round 5 correction: the chain itself is frozen, not re-copied) -- closing the post-construction-mutation vector comprehensively after three rounds of narrower fixes; cyclic previous chains fail closed; evidence.ts's cloneInputs gives a clear error; stale architecture-doc wording corrected. Quality gate: 1716/1716 tests (135/135 files). Next: Codex audit round 4. Round 4 Codex audit fix now in: freezePreviousChain's own Object.isFrozen shortcut removed (spoofable by a shallow freeze wrapper around still-mutable subject/evidence) -- every previous-chain node is now unconditionally walked and frozen. Architecture doc's Measurement account brought up to date through round 4. Quality gate: 1717/1717 tests (135/135 files). Next: Codex audit round 5. Round 5: Codex explicitly confirmed measurement.ts's own farm-scoping/immutability invariant is genuinely closed -- no fifth code bypass found. One documentation wording correction (the previous chain is frozen in place, not re-copied). Next: Codex audit round 6 to confirm a genuinely clean round closes the loop. Round 6: CLEAN (0/0/0/0) -- Codex audit loop closed. Checkpoint 1.5 complete and audited: contracts_frozen flipped back to true in this same bookkeeping commit. See the end-of-campaign report for the full account.
